purpose: Resolve the independently attested CONTROL_GATE_WIRING blocker for PC-CROP #3785 by validating and atomically adding one reversible Compose override that exposes the existing PC_CONTROL_HOST_ENABLED application boundary to the exact running web image.
requiredInvariants: The repair remains exact-main, canonical-DNS, absent-AAAA, pinned-SSH, owner-authorized and concurrency-guarded.
The original production Compose files are never edited; when wiring is absent, exactly one fixed in-workspace file named .company-os-control-host.compose.yml may be created.
The override may add only services.web.environment.PC_CONTROL_HOST_ENABLED with default false; normalized candidate Compose output must otherwise equal the original output byte-for-byte.
Candidate Compose and Caddy configuration must validate before any production config, environment or service changes.

The primary upstream is selected by exact primary-host match when possible; a sole-edge fallback is permitted only when Caddy has exactly one unique reverse-proxy dial and that dial host is a running Compose web DNS alias on the same specific Docker network shared with Caddy.

An already-enabled control route may return no-op success only when its Compose wiring is persistent and its sole reverse_proxy dial is revalidated against the selected current web upstream and the same shared-network identity binding.
The current immutable web image ID and OCI revision remain unchanged; only the web service may be recreated and every non-web container ID, including Caddy, remains unchanged.
Internal rollback restores the environment and Caddy configuration, deletes an override created by this run, and recreates web from only the original Compose file set.
External acceptance failure uses authenticated backup metadata to restore the same state and delete only the exact fixed override path when the run created it.
Remote stderr is suppressed; only bounded uppercase failure stages and non-secret acceptance fields may reach Actions output.
Ten consecutive public acceptance rounds remain mandatory before success is published.
GO remains forbidden until reviewer MFA, First Customer and all 9 of 9 role journeys pass.
acceptance: Workflow YAML and both embedded remote Bash scripts parse before merge.
Read-only readiness returns a READY_*_BEFORE_BACKUP state only after the selected upstream is bound to the running web identity; the current topology may use the bounded SOLE_EDGE_UPSTREAM fallback.

The cutover reports CREATE_OVERRIDE or EXISTING wiring mode plus PRIMARY_HOST_MATCH or SOLE_EDGE_UPSTREAM selection and passes TLS, control-login, host-isolation, parent redirect, API denial, exact-revision and primary-domain checks for 10 of 10 rounds.
Any pre-acceptance failure is either no-mutation or internally rolled back; any public-acceptance failure invokes the authenticated external rollback.
